Groups into Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=4on4 |entrance= |website= |sdate=2000-01-21 |edate=2000-04-29 |twitch= |teamfirst=Flaming Fist |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=CAPSLOCK |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=Euthanasia |teamthirdflag=se |teamthird2=Clan Malfunction |teamthird2flag=fi |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 }} == Introduction == * Round: Villains 2 - Group 2 * Match: {{Flag/se}} [[Flaming Fist]] vs {{Flag/fi}} [[Fraggers United]] * Date: 2000-02-20 == Match report == === DM3 === FF: 297 - FU: 42
[[Image:Ff-fu-dm3.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Flaming Fist.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/f/f2/Ff_vs_fu_dm3_exile.qwz exile (FF)]

"Right after the game i ask myself how to make a match report interesting if the game was quite one sided and because of that boring. The simple answer: i can't :) Dm3 was FF's choice and we all know how good they are on this. They profited of the first Pent and had a lead of 31 - 16 after 3 minutes. Then Pietro got an RL and ran one quad after the next. After one or two minutes, FF had all locations saved and the map locked down. The second and third pent were both taken by Pietro and he directly jumped into the window to grab quad too. Can you imagine how dangerous a Quaded AND Pented Pietro is ? :) Well the game went on the same way, FF increasing their lead until the game ended with a score of 297-42 to FF. Pings were equal (in my opinion...) but the server was changed anyway because FU wanted that. Their pings didn't get better for map number two and they were equal again :)" -Andy === DM2 === FF: 343 - FU: 45
[[Image:Ff-fu-dm2.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Fraggers United.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/4/48/Ff_vs_fu_dm2_pietro.qwz pietro (FF)]

"Somehow aKKe got the first Quad (i guess with a quadladder because no one passed YA tele to that time). He also got RL because on YA tele was a bigger fight happening and no one passed YA tele early enough to take the RL away. He cleared most important areas and after three minutes the score already was 42 - 5 to FF. The map was locked down again by FF after 4 or 5 minutes and then Pietro started to run the Quad. Well, no great comebacks in that game eiter. Just a few frags by FU here and there and two or three times they even stole Quad but FF's victory was never in danger. The final score was 343-45 to FF. Congratulations to Pietro and aKKe for scoring 100 ! gg both teams" -Andy == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** FF: 660 ** FU: 87 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
